scenarios.description: This scan has no qualifying activity at all for a ticker whose current_state (seeded separately in tests/demo seed data) is CONFIRMED. Used to exercise the CONFIRMED -> FADING transition rule (no_gate_passed_while_confirmed), not the NEW path.

Dark-pool anomaly AND one-sided options flow anomaly fire in the same scan. Exercises multi_signal_confirmation -> classify_confidence returns 'high' via the multi-signal path (not the single-gate paths).
Ordinary low-premium flow and a dark-pool print near its own baseline. No gate should pass. Exercises the NEW ticker with zero qualifying gates -> proves the engine does not always say yes.
Single large dark-pool print at ~6.4x its (fabricated) trailing average baseline. Exercises the dark_pool_anomaly gate alone, with a strong ratio pushing confidence to 'high'.
One-sided ask-side call sweep with no corresponding dark-pool activity. Exercises the options_flow_anomaly gate alone (single-signal, not multi-signal).
